sections.note: Each city and municipality sets its rates within the statutory limits (lower up to 20% for municipalities, 21% for cities, 22% for large cities and county seats, 23% for the City of Zagreb; higher rate up to 30%, 31%, 32% and 33% respectively); 20% / 30% apply where no decision was made.
